status: PROPOSED — generated by misaka-palw-gen-ref2 (scripts/gen_proposed_vectors.sh), held equal to kaspa-consensus-core's palw_gen_step_v1; the preimages are the shipped ones, recovered by fitting, not from a text (docs/design/palw/gen/ref2-findings.md G18)
spec: docs/rfc/0003-palw-generative-model-classes.md §II.2.1 (As built: keyed leaves, a Merkle root per stage bound with its count, one step root over the stage roots); the preimages below are the proposed text

preimages.hash: H(key, m) = BLAKE2b-512 keyed with the ASCII bytes of key, over m
preimages.coord: u8 stage ‖ le32 position ‖ kind ‖ le32 tile; kind = 0 ‖ le16 occurrence ‖ le16 node (a commit point's tile) or 1 ‖ le16 state ‖ option(le16 layer) (a Fixed state's checkpoint tile); option = 0, or 1 ‖ le16
preimages.leaf: H(leaf key, coord ‖ le32 value_count ‖ lane_0 ‖ lane_1 ‖ …), each lane the low 32 bits of its two's complement, little-endian; a leaf binds neither its dtype nor its first element
preimages.node: H(node key, left ‖ right); a level's last node, if it has no sibling, is promoted unchanged; a single leaf is its own Merkle root
preimages.path: a leaf's siblings bottom-up, one per level where the node has a sibling (a promoted node contributes none)
preimages.stage_root: H(stage-root key, u8 stage ‖ le64 leaf_count ‖ merkle_root over the stage's leaf hashes in step-tree order)
preimages.step_root: H(step-root key, le16 stage_count ‖ stage_root_0 ‖ … ‖ stage_root_(n-1))
preimages.tree: A stage's leaves, per position a in 0..trip, in this order: (1) for each occurrence o (0 = the program's pre block, 1…L = its layer blocks in order, L+1 = its post block) every node with commit = true in node order, tile by tile — tile_len is the layout's commit_tiles entry for that node (the committed nodes numbered in (block, node) order over the program's blocks), ceil(elements / tile_len) tiles at this position, the last one ragged; the post occurrence only from position post_from (0 for a Rows or Final program, |prompt| - 1 for a text stage, whose logits are leaves only where the decode consumes them); (2) if (a + 1) % checkpoint_interval == 0, every Fixed state instance not written in post, in (state, layer) order, tile by tile (state_tiles). There are no Hist tile leaves (finding G14). The stages are concatenated stage-major. Values are read off the honest run of the source pipeline vector (programs, params, job, seed, item index) under the stated layouts.
